messages:
external_auditor (PwC): Hi team — for the SOC2/ISO bundle we need three artifacts: 1) a sample of RBAC role-change audit logs (before/after diffs showing actor, timestamp, and justification), 2) KMS rotation evidence for service keys over the last 12 months, and 3) proxy/gateway access logs around incident #783 (we asked for Nov 2025 window). Prefer CSV or screenshots. Can you confirm what you can provide and any limitations?

maria (SecEng): We can provide RBAC audit trail from our cloud audit logs for 2025-04-01..2026-03-31. Native export is JSONL; we can convert to CSV with the diff columns you asked for. We will redact session tokens and any PII.

chris (Infra): Proxy logs live in s3://redwood-gateway-logs/ with Athena partitions by dt. Retention is 13 months. We can export raw request/response headers but will need to redact IPs by default unless you confirm. Which exact time range do you want?

external_auditor (PwC): Thanks — target window for proxy logs is 2025-11-01..2025-11-30, and specifically highlight spikes tied to incident #783 (looks like 2025-11-15). For RBAC, we need both the change event and the pre-change role snapshot. For KMS: provide key metadata, scheduleRotation events, and signed rotation manifests if available. Redact customer PII where required.

maria (SecEng): Quick Q — Are customer-managed keys (delegated to Dedicated customers) in-scope? We only control metadata for those; actual rotation actions are customer-side. If in-scope, we'll need authorization to request artifacts from the customer.

sam (ProductSecurity): FYI incident #783 triage shows a traffic spike at 2025-11-15T03:12:00Z and a fallback to smaller model at 03:14:40Z. Link to triage notes: https://redwood.internal/triage/783 — include those traces. Also confirm whether you need full request bodies or just headers and status codes.

chris (Infra): I can run an Athena export. Example query I'll use (will redact IPs after export):
```
SELECT request_id, event_time, http_method, path, status, user_agent, source_ip, headers
FROM "gateway_logs".events
WHERE dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30'
  AND event_time BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-11-15 00:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-11-16 00:00:00'
  AND path LIKE '/v1/%'
ORDER BY event_time
LIMIT 50000;
```
I will replace source_ip with hashed values for the auditor export unless you request original IPs with a data access justification.

maria (SecEng): Action plan I will produce: 1) RBAC CSV with columns [change_ts, actor, target_principal, before_roles, after_roles, reason, audit_log_id] for sample window 2025-10-01..2025-12-31 (we'll pick 25 events including the Nov spike), 2) KMS package with key metadata, rotation schedule events, and rotation manifest where present, 3) Proxy CSV slices (Nov 1-30) with headers redacted except user_agent/status/path. I'll also attach a short runbook snippet describing how we collect/export these artifacts and the retention/TTL.

compliance-bot: evidence_request_created EVID-2026-143 assigned to @maria (SecEng) — upload target: s3://redwood-audit-uploads/pwcaudit/2026-03/ EOD 2026-03-22.

maria (SecEng): Thanks — I'll prepare exports and upload by EOD 2026-03-22. @external_auditor (PwC) please confirm if you require original source_ip fields or hashed values. Also confirm whether delegated customer keys should be included or if we should exclude them and annotate where keys are customer-managed. :thumbsup:

external_auditor (PwC): Hashed IPs are fine for now; we may request originals later with justification. Delegated/customer-managed keys: please annotate and provide evidence of our requests sent to customers if rotation proof is incomplete. Thanks!

maria (SecEng): Great — will package RBAC diffs + KMS metadata + proxy samples, note delegated keys in the manifest, and include the triage link. Upload ETA remains EOD 2026-03-22. Closing loop here unless anyone needs to add more.
